name: Sandoku Ryouran
source:
Shukumi Town --
A few years ago, a young female mayor was elected, and since then, this town has been making remarkable and completely unexpected progress.
In one corner of the town, there are people who secretly work as exorcists.

Yasakani Setsuna
Shukugi Sakuya
Watatsumi Konoha

The members of the special forces "Yatagarasu" were ordered to investigate a series of incidents involving young girls.

However, a mysterious woman appears in the shadows of the successive incidents...
The number of evildoers is increasing without any clues being found...
And a new request has been made to investigate an orgy party at Shukumi Academy...

Unable to grasp the full extent of the incident, the members of "Yatagarasu" continue to be at the mercy of the people.
What is the purpose of the one who controls all the threads?

from www.cyberworks.jp
translation:
宿见町——
几年前，一位年轻的女市长当选，从那时起，这个小镇就取得了令人瞩目的、完全出乎意料的进步。
在小镇的一角，有人秘密从事驱魔师的工作。

八坂刹那
宿木作也
木叶渡巳

特种部队“八咫乌”的成员奉命调查一系列涉及年轻女孩的事件。

然而，在接二连三的事件的阴影下，一名神秘女子出现了……
恶人越来越多，却没有发现任何线索……
并且接到了调查宿美学园的狂欢派对的新请求……

由于无法掌握事件的全部真相，“八咫乌”的成员们继续受到人们的摆布。
控制所有线程的人的目的是什么？
